summary: Short residential kerb with homes on both sides, 11 to 20 m away.
reasons: Only a few cars parked nearby

drivers.seclusion: Houses 11 to 24 m away on both sides of the street; the south side backs onto residential gardens.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain sealed street; room to stop at the kerb, only 30 m of it.
drivers.convention: A few cars park near the driveways, but no clear parking convention.

sun_shade: Partly shaded by a large tree to the north-east; otherwise open.

best_section.where: South kerb of Dobell Street beside the garden-backed lot, near the driveway cars
